note: First round is Version 0. The file shows no sign of a transfer from another journal. R2 and R5 are Early Career co-reviewers who wrote no independent assessment, and neither says which referee they worked with. R2 is assigned R1's recommendation because it directly follows R1 and R1's round-2 report is signed by two people (Ramos-Alonso and Ochoa); this is still an inference. R5's pairing is uncertain: it is assigned R4's recommendation only because it directly follows R4, but it could instead belong with R3 (major revision). R3 gives no explicit verdict in round 1. It was classed as major revision because it requests substantial new analysis: a quantitative e-ph estimate, cross-device comparison tables, normalized plots, and optionally data at other frequencies and noise thermometry. Its positive tone means minor revision is also arguable. R4 conditionally recommends publication with a set of concerns to address, so it was classed as minor revision.
